content.short: HyperSig brings multisig approvals to Hyperliquid operations such as staking, vaults and transfers.
content.description: HyperSig is a multisig layer built for Hyperliquid, letting a team approve actions collectively rather than trusting a single key. It covers the operations that matter on this chain specifically: staking, vault management, limit orders, agent wallets and transfers. Standard EVM multisigs do not reach HyperCore, which is what makes a Hyperliquid-native approach necessary.
content.meta: HyperSig is a Hyperliquid-native multisig for staking, vaults, agent wallets and transfers.
